Version 1.0 | 14 October 2026
This document defines 118 traceable test cases for QA and acceptance testers. Execute the cases to verify
every in-scope page, customer record tab, dialog, state transition and cross-module handoff. Each case
includes setup, concrete actions and an expected outcome so that failures can be reproduced and reviewed.
Execution status All cases start as Not run. This is a test specification and execution worksheet, not a claim
that the application has passed these scenarios. Record the tested build, actual results and evidence before
assigning Pass or Fail.

Scope and use
Module 1 includes the six Administration pages: Overview, Users, Roles & permissions, Access requests, Audit
trail and My security. Sign in, customer registration and Account-holder access key are included because they
create or control the same identity and access state. Overview here is the IAM page, distinct from the general
banking overview.
Module 2 includes Customer directory and all four customer tabs: Profile, KYC and evidence, Relationships and
consent, and Audit. Case evidence is a panel within KYC and evidence. IAM detail sections are panels or
dialogs, not additional tabs.
Account, deposit, payment, product, card and loan functionality is checked only where it consumes customer
eligibility or prevents CIF closure. Full functional testing of those modules is outside this document. Use
synthetic customers and isolated fixtures for closures, lockouts, concurrency and injected failures.

Local setup The repository start.ps1 builds and starts the local stack; the root README describes
http://localhost:5173 and /employee/login. The local stack resets synthetic data when stopped. Use a dedicated
test run and the environment credential handoff; never embed passwords, holder keys, MFA secrets or tokens
in evidence.
Clock and configuration Use a controlled clock or purpose-built fixtures for expiry boundaries. Do not change
the workstation clock. Confirm actual configuration; defaults in LoginService are 5 failed attempts, 15-minute
credential lock, 30-minute idle session and 8-hour absolute session. Fresh MFA is accepted through age 300
seconds inclusive.
Inspection Use UI plus an authorized API client and read-only database inspection. All endpoint paths in this
document are relative to /api/v1. Fault injection and database immutability probes use disposable fixtures.
Capture before/after counts, statuses and versions; restore only the fixtures changed by the test.
Data naming Use a run prefix such as QA_M12_20261014 and unique usernames/identifier values per
accepted variant. Use qa.customer@example.test and synthetic telephone numbers. Take dates relative to the
application business date, and never use real identity documents.
Execution method and acceptance criteria
Each numbered case can contain several parameter variants. Run every stated variant, assign a suffix such as
a, b or c, and record an individual result. A case passes only when all required variants pass. A missing
prerequisite is Blocked, not Pass. A deliberately unavailable deployment feature is Not applicable only with a
recorded reason and reviewer acceptance.
